name: Sales documents and NRA audit file (Н-18)
description: For e-shops in Bulgaria under the alternative regime of Наредба Н-18 (чл. 52м–52у): the numbered sale document with QR code for card and payment-provider payments (чл. 52о), the accompanying document for cash on delivery paid as a postal money order (чл. 3, ал. 1), and the monthly standardized audit file for NRA (Приложение 38).

permissions.label: See sales documents and download the NRA audit file

settings.label: Seller (legal name)
settings.help: As registered, e.g. "Example EOOD". Printed on every document.

settings.label: NRA e-shop number
settings.help: The unique number NRA gave the e-shop when it was registered (Приложение 33). Used in the QR code and the audit file.

options.1: Its own or a rented domain

settings.label: How each payment method is paid
settings.default:
stripe=4
paypal=4
bank_transfer=1
cod=3
store_credit=5
invoice=1
settings.help: One line per gateway: gateway=code. 1 bank transfer (no document needed), 2 virtual POS of the shop's own account, 3 cash on delivery as a postal money order, 4 payment service provider, 5 other payment without a fiscal receipt, 6 paid with a fiscal receipt. Sale documents are issued for codes 2 and 4.

settings.label: Payment service providers
settings.help: One line per gateway: gateway=identifier and name, e.g. stripe=IE3206651KH Stripe Payments Europe Ltd. Goes into the audit file (PROC_ID).

settings.label: Virtual POS number
settings.help: For code 2 payments (virtual POS of the shop's own account).

settings.label: Send a document for cash on delivery
settings.help: Code 3 orders: emailed when the parcel is shipped (чл. 25, ал. 3).

settings.label: First document number
settings.help: Numbers rise by one and never repeat across the business. Set it when continuing from another program.

author: PN Scripts
